purpose: Experiment E-FRC-0234 in the gauge arena: the balanced split lives in the column, not in the mode: the virial theorem makes every mode fill its link columns and its square columns in the ratio f / s alone, so one integer split, f / s = links per square, balances every mode at once, and with it a hot box of the plaquette ladder's quantum light reaches Planck where E-FRC-0232's drift-carried split fell short.
known_limitations: Depth L2 (L2: known physics reproduced on a stated model).
